dataset.name: graphsense-zcash-accounting-validation
dataset.description: Real Zcash mainnet transactions with known-correct accounting, for comparing graphsense-lib before and after its correction of Orchard and Ironwood value balances. Ten blocks, every transaction of each block, and every earlier transaction whose transparent outputs they spend.

changes: First dataset: 10 blocks, 47 transactions, 43 previous transactions.
Seven blocks are the mainnet test fixtures of graphsense-lib (pull request #163), reused unchanged.
Added blocks 1687119, 1687143 and 3438010, and the previous transactions, captured from Zebra 6.4.2.

before.role: The last graphsense-lib release without the correction of Orchard and Ironwood value balances.

after.role: The first graphsense-lib release with the correction (pull request #163).

graphsense-lib-fixtures.description: Mainnet test fixtures of graphsense-lib, contributed with its pull request #163 and reused here byte for byte.

node.version_source: Stated in the description of graphsense-lib pull request #163. The files show the byte order of Orchard and Ironwood anchors that Zebra used before 6.4.0.

graphsense-lib-fixtures.encoding: The result member of `getblock <height> 2`, written again by a JSON library: separators are ', ' and ': ', and some decimal numbers are spelled in exponent form. Every number denotes the same value as in the node's own output.
graphsense-lib-fixtures.capture_time_note: Not recorded by the origin. The gzip headers of the seven files carry times between 2026-09-12T02:58:47Z and 2026-09-12T07:34:48Z.

zebra-6.4.2.description: Captured for this dataset: all ten blocks and the 43 previous transactions.

node.version_source: `getinfo` of the node at capture time.

zebra-6.4.2.encoding: The bytes of the result member of the JSON-RPC response, exactly as the node sent them.

capture_differences_allowed.reason: The number of confirmations grows with every new block. GraphSense does not read it.
Zebra prints the anchor of an Orchard or Ironwood bundle in the opposite byte order since version 6.4.0. GraphSense does not read it.
